id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

column.description:
The number of columns (1-12) that the container should take up.
12 will take up the entire content area of the page.

display.description: The direction children components should be displayed in.

padding.description: Padding to squeeze the whole content inside

background.description:
The background color of the container.
By default will `INHERIT` the background of the parent container. If there is no parent container,
will not have a background and behave like OFF configuration.
If background is set to `AUTO`, container will render a background with the correct nested styles
If set to `OFF`, no background will be rendered.

border.description: Border true will render a border around the container.

justifyContent.description:
Specifies the distribution of the children components along the main axis. Note that for this setting to be
effective, you must set the `stretch` value of your child UiSdlComponentComponentContainer to `false`.
This is because when `stretch` is set to `true`, the component container child element will take up the whole
space of its parent, so justifying content will have no effect.

overflow.description:
Specifies the overflow behavior of the container.
By default overflow.x and overflow.y are set to UNSET.

children.description:
Since the {@link UiSdlGridContainer} only defines the grid structure,
the children further define that and only {@link UiSdlComponentContainer}
can actually reference other components.

Adding the columns of all of the children should equal this container's number of columns.

title: A container to be used in {@link UiSdlGridLayout} that contains multiple children.
name: UiSdlGridContainer
